cohort: 118 pregnant women infected with SARS-CoV-2 during pregnancy
finding: While most pregnant women with COVID-19 infections had mild symptoms, moderate-to-severe infection, primarily due to COVID-19 pneumonia, was associated with preterm labor and preeclampsia but not directly with neonatal outcomes or placental histopathology changes.
mod_finding: The majority of women with moderate-to-severe COVID-19 infection required cesarean section (37.5%).
